prompt: What reason did the officer give for frisking your client? Select all that apply.

options.label: No reason given, or only general officer safety
The kind of crime suspected (e.g. drugs, burglary)
Something about a companion or the location (e.g. a search warrant for the place)
A bulge or object that looked like a weapon
Your client didn't follow commands (e.g. show hands)
A tip or information that your client was armed
The officer saw a weapon or your client said they had one

prompt: What did the officer do during the pat-down? Select all that apply.

options.label: Reached into pockets or clothing without first feeling something that could be a weapon
Removed an item that could not have been a weapon
Kept squeezing, sliding, or manipulating an object after it was clear it wasn't a weapon
